simple.summary: נַעֲרָן (Naʻărân) means Naaran , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 7 28.

definitions.full: H5295. Naaran נַעֲרָן proper name, of a location in E of Ephraim , 1Chr 7:28 ( ᵐ5 Νααρναν , A Νααραν , ᵐ5 L Νοαραν ), apparently = [ נַעֲרָה ] q. v. נֹף see מֹף .
